notes.title: Square Heroes gets Korean language support
notes.content:
Patch 1.6.2 was recently released with the following changes:
[list]
[*] Korean language support. Many thanks to the very generous fan [b]dollppin[/b] for translating and testing it for us. Please tell all your Steam buddies from Korea to check out the store page and see if it tickles their fancy!
[*] The Alien King is now less difficult to defeat, making the [b]Kingslayer[/b] and [b]Achievement Hunter[/b] achievements easier to obtain. We acknowledge that he was massively OP. ːsteamfacepalmː
[*] Various small bug fixes.
[/list]
As always, happy friend-fragging! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Square Heroes 1.6 Major Update
notes.content:
Square Heroes 1.6 released in conjunction with the upcoming release of [url=https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/square-heroes-ps4]Square Heroes on PlayStation® 4[/url]

There are a raft of new features and fixes, so let's get right to it:

[h1]NEW FEATURES / CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Cross-platform play with PlayStation® 4 (in addition to Windows, Linux and Mac)
[*] Added Japanese language
[*] Reduced XP required to level up to higher levels
[*] Allow Heroes to have the same name
[*] Added location to replay tutorial (near the professor) 
[*] Kingslayer mode now allows re-spawn if co-op friends still alive
[*] Link new Hero to Steam account even after first Create Hero dialog
[*] Added UPnP port mapping setting to fix connection issues for some
[/list]

[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Suicide bug when hit an enemy’s projectile with melee
[*] Steam Achievements not awarded when language not English
[*] Steam overlay on Mac
[*] Deathmatch end level detection in net games when host is the last kill
[*] Reduced crate pick-up time to mitigate crate synch issues with high latency remotes.
[*] Various rare bugs
[*] Network error on Windows XP 
[/list]

notes.title: Square Heroes 1.5 released with FREE DEMO!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Private Games[/b][/h1]
Internet games can now be password protected so only your friends can join. 

[h1][b]Free Demo[/b][/h1] - [URL=http://store.steampowered.com/app/365000]download page[/URL]
For the first time a demo of Square Heroes has been released. Demo players are able to create and jump into [b]online matches[/b], so expect an influx of new players! The online modes are a huge part of the game, but we can't give everything away for free. The demo has these limitations:
[list]
[*] 3 out of the 19 Single Player levels.
[*] No Achievements, and hence no stat tweaking hats!
[*] XP Level capped at 5 rather than 30.
[*] 5 default weapons plus 4 weapons to unlock.
[/list]

[h1][b]Other[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Nuke explosion effect (when you get it, you will see it).
[*]Numerous bug fixes.
[/list]

Happy Hunting :D 

PS: No need to go easy on the demo players. Even though they can't upgrade to the Sticky Bombs, Proximity Mines, Nuke bags and Molotovs, the weapons are balanced enough for them to cause you plenty of grief!
